items.raw_excerpt: K'gari's Kingfisher Bay Resort is set to be taken over by US-owned "experiential tourism" giant Journey Beyond.
items.summary_en: Kingfisher Bay Resort on K'gari will be taken over by Journey Beyond, a US-owned tourism company. This deal changes who runs the island's famous resort.

items.raw_excerpt: Netball has long lacked Indigenous representation at the elite level. The introduction of the First Nations Tournament and Black Swans are some measures the code is taking to address cultural safety.
items.summary_en: Netball has long lacked Indigenous representation at the elite level. The introduction of the First Nations Tournament and Black Swans are some measures the code is taking to address cultural safety.

items.title_original: First Nations netballers driving change, bringing cultural safety

items.raw_excerpt: オープンから約30年、札幌すすきので愛され続けているスイーツの名店「アイスクリームBar HOKKAIDOミルク村」。こだわりの特製アイスクリームにアルコールの効いたリキュールをかけていただくスイーツは、まさに大人の味。甘く軽いリキュールから年代物のブランデーやウイスキーまで味わうことができる唯一無二のお店を紹介します。
items.summary_en: HOKKAIDO Milk Village is a famous sweets shop in Susukino, Sapporo that people have loved for about 30 years. The shop pours liqueur over its special ice cream. Guests can enjoy everything from sweet light liqueurs to aged brandy and whiskey.

items.title_en: Sapporo's loved sweets shop serves ice cream with 130 kinds of liqueur

items.title_original: 札幌すすきのの名店「HOKKAIDOミルク村」 130種のリキュール×アイスの大人な極上スイーツ体験 - domingo.ne.jp

items.raw_excerpt: Pet owners and dog lovers in Morelia kicked off Independence Day festivities early by taking part in a Most Patriotic Pup contest.
items.summary_en: Pet owners in Morelia started Independence Day early with a Most Patriotic Pup contest. One dog wore a costume of a taco stand and won first prize.

items.raw_excerpt: Te reo Māori is being learnt by more people across Aotearoa, as the language continues to be revitalised across generations.
items.summary_en: More people across New Zealand are learning te reo Maori. The language is being renewed and passed on to new generations. Learners say it gives a deeper understanding of the country.

items.raw_excerpt: Exemplares foram recuperados Operação Dom Pedro II da Polícia Federal.
items.summary_en: Brazil's Federal Police returned recovered historical publications to the National Library. The items were reclaimed during the 'Dom Pedro II' police operation. The books are now back in the library's collection.

items.raw_excerpt: Earlier this year, businessman David Penman brought charges against five of the Hepburn Shire Council's seven councillors, who were forced to stand down.
items.summary_en: Earlier this year, businessman David Penman brought charges against five of Hepburn Shire Council's seven councillors. The councillors were forced to stand down. Now the council has closed the loophole behind this rare private court case.

items.raw_excerpt: A company founded by Chinese Academy of Sciences researchers has developed a 6 kg CT scanner that it says is the world's smallest, a portable device built to image the inside of small objects.
items.summary_en: A company started by Chinese Academy of Sciences researchers made a 6 kg CT scanner. They say it is the world's smallest portable scanner. It is built to take pictures of the inside of small objects.

items.raw_excerpt: La tradicional fonda del Parque Alejo Barrios, ubicada en el sector de Playa Ancha en Valparaíso, dio inicio este jueves a su primera jornada de celebraciones de Fiestas Patrias. El recinto destaca en la pauta festiva por mantener el acceso totalmente gratuito para el público y ofrecer precios económicos en sus diferentes ramadas y cocinerías. Con la apertura de sus principales recintos festivos, la región se consolida como uno de los destinos predilectos para el turismo nacional durante estas f
items.summary_en: The traditional Fiestas Patrias fair at Alejo Barrios Park in Playa Ancha, Valparaiso started this Thursday. The site keeps free entry for the public and offers low prices at its food stalls. The region is becoming a favorite spot for national tourism during the holidays.
items.summary_ko: 발파라이소 플라야 안차의 알레호 바리오스 공원에서 전통 국경일 축제인 폰다가 시작됐습니다. 이곳은 입장료를 전혀 받지 않고 여러 식당과 매점의 가격도 저렴하게 유지합니다. 이 지역은 연휴 기간 국내 관광객이 가장 선호하는 여행지로 자리잡고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Valparaiso park opens free national holiday fair
items.title_ko: 발파라이소 공원, 무료 입장 국경일 축제 개막
items.title_original: Con acceso liberado, el Alejo Barrios dio el vamos a las celebraciones dieciocheras en Valparaíso

items.raw_excerpt: Iniciativas desenvolvidas por professores e estudantes de escolas em diferentes regiões do Brasil têm transformado materiais descartados em novos recursos e produtos que ajudam a resolver problemas locais. Além de receber um prêmio em dinheiro, as escolas campeãs seguem agora para a etapa internacional da competição, que ocorrerá na Cidade do México, em 2 de dezembro.
items.summary_en: Students and teachers across Brazil turned discarded materials into new resources and helpful products. The winning schools now move to the international round in Mexico City on December 2nd.
items.summary_ko: 브라질 곳곳의 학교 학생과 교사들이 버려진 재료를 새 자원과 유용한 제품으로 바꾸는 활동을 펼쳤습니다. 수상한 학교들은 오는 12월 2일 멕시코시티에서 열리는 국제 대회에 진출합니다.
items.title_en: Schools in Bahia and Pará win national sustainability prize

items.raw_excerpt: A rough excursion for a very large dog and her two owners ended on a positive note last weekend, with a full-service stretcher ride down a mountain near Revelstoke, B.C.
items.summary_en: A very large dog hurt her paws on a mountain near Revelstoke, B.C. Her two owners could not carry her back down. Rescuers gave the dog a full-service stretcher ride to safety.
items.summary_ko: 브리티시컬럼비아주 리벨스토크 인근 산에서 큰 그레이트 데인이 발을 다쳤습니다. 주인 둘도 개를 들고 내려갈 수 없었고, 구조대가 편안한 들것에 태워 산에서 내려오는 데 도움을 줬습니다. 모두 무사히 내려왔습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Fall colours, quaint streets, and tumbling waterfalls await near this beautiful Ontario small town.
items.summary_en: This small town is about an hour from Toronto. It sits in a valley of red and gold leaves with tall waterfalls. It is a good place for short hikes in fall.

items.raw_excerpt: FDA suspends Café Mondegar's license for food safety violations amid a wider crackdown on Mumbai eateries during festival season.
items.summary_en: Food officials stopped the licence of Cafe Mondegar, a famous eatery in Mumbai. The action is part of a bigger check on restaurants in the city during festival season.

items.raw_excerpt: Joanna Wietrzyk said she decided to "retroactively withdraw from the race" and forfeit the points she earned.
items.summary_en: An Australian Hyrox athlete has apologized for continuing a race in Beijing after an accident. She said she chose to retire from the race and hand back the points she earned. She called her choice to keep running a mistake.

items.raw_excerpt: The Bureau of Meteorology has made major updates to the rain radar on its website, nearly a year since its widely criticised launch.
items.summary_en: Australia's weather bureau made big updates to the rain radar on its website. The change comes nearly a year after the site was widely criticized when it launched. Users will now see clearer and more useful rain maps.

items.raw_excerpt: The Konaseema Railway Line project remains stalled 25 years after its inception, impacting local farmers and regional connectivity.
items.summary_en: The Konaseema Railway Line project is still stalled 25 years after it started. Local farmers and people in the region say the lack of a train line hurts them. They want the project to finally move forward.

items.raw_excerpt: Parceria com Victória Barros supera rivais com quase o dobro da idade
items.summary_en: At the SP Open beach volleyball tournament, player Nana Silva lost one match but won in the doubles with her partner Victoria Barros. The young pair beat rivals who were almost twice their age.
items.summary_ko: SP오픈 비치발리볼 대회에서 나나 실바가 한 경기를 패한 뒤, 파트너 빅토리아 바호스와 함께 복식 경기에 나서 승리했다. 어린 두 선수는 자신들보다 나이가 거의 두 배 많은 상대를 꺾었다.

items.raw_excerpt: La rotura de una matriz de alcantarillado obligó a suspender, dado el evidente riesgo sanitario, el inicio de las celebraciones en la comuna nortina.
items.summary_en: A broken sewer pipe spilled waste through Alto Hospicio, a town in northern Chile. Because of the health risk, the opening of the local fondas, traditional stalls for Chile's national holiday, was postponed. Locals nicknamed the mess the 'river of poo'.

items.title_original: Río de caca emporcó la inauguración de las fondas en Alto Hospicio

items.raw_excerpt: The A-League Men and Women seasons are just one month away. However, that start date is at risk as the nation's referees go on strike over "detrimental" and "untenable" changes over their work conditions.
items.summary_en: Australia's A-League Men and Women seasons start in one month. But the start date is in danger because referees are on strike. They are protesting changes to their work conditions, which they call unfair.

items.title_en: A-League season start under threat with referees on strike
